description: ConfigQuote helps merchants sell products that need options, rules, or custom pricing before checkout. Shoppers can configure products on the storefront, submit a quote request, and receive a clear branded quote, while merchants manage pricing logic, approvals, templates, and quote workflows in one place. It is especially useful for stores selling made-to-order, configurable, or inquiry-first products where standard add-to-cart flows are not enough.
